title: Circular - Email Notification to Ld. Advocates of District and Taluka Courts
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: 02-10-2020

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
IT CELL
CIRCULAR
Date: 02-10-2020
Email Notifications to Ld. Advocates of District / Taluka Courts
on case filing, registration, adjournment, disposal and order / judgement
This is to bring to the notice of all concerned that, looking to the present
scenario of entry restrictions into the campuses of the Courts and also in order
to strengthen the eServices delivery of District & Taluka Courts, Honourable the
Chief Justice on recommendation of the Honourable Judges of the ICT &
eGovernance Committee, has been pleased to direct that, email notifications to
Ld. Advocates of the District and Taluka Courts will be sent for the following
events:
1. New Case Filing
2. Case Registration
3. Adjournment (Next Date)
4. Disposal of Case
5. Order / Judgement [with PDF attachment in email]
The email notifications will be subject to the data updated by the
concerned Court and the same being uploaded in time. As far as possible, the
email notification will be sent by the system by next working day of the
event/uploading.
As these email notifications can only be sent to the registered email
address of the Ld. Advocates of the particular case, Ld. Advocates who have not
registered their email address may please have the same registered with the
Computer Center of the concerned Court Complex. The mobile number and
email address can be registered by sending duly signed application in soft copy
to concerned court through email.
Sd/-
REGISTRAR GENERAL
Copy to:
Principal Judicial Officers of all the District / City Civil / Family / Metro. Courts
